instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. In a grassy park with trees, the Asian man in the red polo (R3) stands center-right, leaning forward excitedly with arms bent and shouting. Behind him to the left, the woman with the afro (R6) in a red t-shirt watches the action. In the background on the right, the woman in the dark t-shirt (R4) smiles. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the vibrant red shirts against the green grass.
